author: Jane Doe
executive_summary:
Acme runs fleet tracking on a self-hosted platform that is near end of life.
Outages during peak season & slow reports drive this migration to a managed cloud platform.
objectives: Move fleet tracking to a managed cloud platform with no data loss
Cut report generation time from hours to minutes
Hand over runbooks so Acme's team can operate the platform
vendor_overview: SkyTek Labs is a cloud engineering firm based in Jakarta. It designs, migrates and operates data platforms for logistics and financial services clients across Southeast Asia.
client_overview: Acme Logistics runs a fleet of 1,200 vehicles across Singapore and Malaysia. Tracking runs on a self-hosted platform in a colocation facility.
functional_requirements: Ingest GPS positions from all 1,200 vehicles every 30 seconds
Generate daily route and fuel reports for operations managers
Keep 3 years of tracking history queryable
architecture_overview: Vehicle telemetry streams into a managed message queue, lands in a time-series store, and feeds a reporting warehouse.

integrations.name: Fuel card system
integrations.description: Nightly import of fuel transactions into the reporting warehouse

phases.name: Discovery
phases.focus: Assess the current platform and data, and agree the target design.

phases.name: Migration
phases.focus: Build the target platform and move 3 years of history onto it.

phases.name: Hypercare
phases.focus: Stabilise the platform and hand it over to Acme's team.

deliverables.name: Migrated platform
deliverables.description: Production environment with 3 years of migrated data

acceptance_criteria:
Acme reviews each deliverable within five business days of handover.
A deliverable is accepted on written sign-off or when the review window passes without written objection.
assumptions: Acme provides admin access to the current platform by kick-off
Source data volume does not exceed 2 TB

risks.risk: Source data quality is worse than expected
risks.mitigation: Profile data in Discovery and agree clean-up rules before migration

success_criteria: All 1,200 vehicles reporting on the new platform
Daily reports complete in under 5 minutes

vendor_roles.responsibilities: Runs the engagement, reporting and client alignment

client_roles.responsibilities: Escalation point; approves deliverables and change orders
